name: Corning Costar 3512 12 well
author: Ramona Optics
notes: Corning Costar 12 well cell culture multiple well plate, clear virgin polystyrene (meets USP Class VI), flat-bottom round wells, TC-treated, sterile, with lid. Cat# 3512 is the bulk-pack item (5/pack, 100/case), registered here; the identical mould is also sold as 3513 (individually wrapped) and 3336 - Corning's dimension sheet lists 3336/3512/3513 on a single row and the Product Descriptions for 3512 (rev 11) and 3513 (rev 13) are dimensionally identical line for line, so any of these can use this definition. The non-treated 12 well equivalent is 3737 and was not checked against this drawing. CONTROLLING DOCUMENT: Corning customer drawing DWG00674 Rev C, 'COSTAR 12 WELL PLATE WITH COVER', drawn CBL 10/03/96, rev C dated 6/22/18, prod code 144; its Rev B note ('REVISED PER CO# 05780 WAS 144-3512') is what ties this drawing to catalogue number 3512. The drawing is vector with no text layer and was read as a 100 dpi render. Every dimension in this file is a millimetre value in parentheses on that drawing: plate length 127.89 mm, plate width 85.60 mm, plate height without cover 20.02 mm (the drawing's .788 in / 20.02 dimension on the section view; the separate base+cover stack view gives 22.61 mm WITH the cover on, and the Product Description's 'Height with lid 0.890 in' is that same lid-on number - the lid is not modeled here, so the lid-off 20.02 mm is used). Well center-to-center 26.01 mm, marked 'Typ.' and identical in both axes. Well top inside diameter 22.73 mm, recorded in 'diameter' per the top-diameter convention; well bottom inside diameter 22.11 mm. Well depth 17.53 mm. Grid is 3 rows (A-C) x 4 columns (1-4) with A1 top-left, as drawn. A1 well center offsets are dimensioned directly on the drawing's top view: 24.94 mm from the left edge and 16.79 mm from the top edge - no derivation was needed, and they agree with Corning's convention that 'A1 Column Offset' is measured from the left and 'A1 Row Offset' from the top. Bottom thickness 1.27 mm and well bottom elevation above the plate underside 2.16 mm (working-distance numbers; not fields in this schema). Well volume 6.90 mL, working volume 3 mL per the Product Description, growth/bottom area 3.83 cm^2, flange/skirt height 13.72 mm. Drawing tolerances are 'nominal for reference only'; the Product Description states +/- 0.050 in on its dimensions. CROSS-CHECK: Corning's family sheet 'Microplate Dimensions for Corning Cell Culture Microplates' dated 1/16/2019 (footer 'Corning Restricted'; no longer served from corning.com and read from the Internet Archive snapshot web.archive.org/web/20240119081431if_/https://www.corning.com/catalog/cls/documents/drawings/MD_Microplate_Dimension_Sheets_Multiple_Well.pdf) agrees with the drawing on every value except well depth, where it rounds 17.53 to 17.5; the per-catalogue drawing wins. Product Description read from certs-ecatalog.corning.com/life-sciences/product-descriptions/3512.pdf. Note that www.corning.com returns 403 to a bare curl and to a browser user-agent alone; a full browser header set including Referer and Sec-Fetch-* is needed to download DWG00674. Units in meters. Use 'pitch' and origin reference to compute all well centers.
